newsitem.title: UK: UK"s Major ducks question on election date.
newsitem.headline: UK"s Major ducks question on election date.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major on Thursday declined to answer a question in parliament on when the general election will be held.
Asked by Paddy Ashdown, leader of the minority Liberal Democrats, to "name the day", Major gave no direct reply.
He instead contrasted his government's economic performance with that of a period in the late 1970s when the Liberals helped to keep a Labour government in office. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
